item.question: How does discarding q-axis dynamics affect noise reduction in power networks?
item.answer: Discarding q-axis dynamics improves noise rejection, resulting in lower RMSPE values for resistance and inductance when only d-axis dynamics are used, enhancing estimation accuracy.
